test-set.name: schematron-edition
test-set.description: The schematronEdition attribute of the schema.

test-case.name: edition-absent
test-case.description: Without schematronEdition (which schemas should specify) the schema is still correct.

test-case.name: edition-other-value
test-case.description: Where specified, the value shall be 2025.

test-case.name: edition-reported
test-case.description: Implementations shall report the value or the absence of schematronEdition at user option; how is the implementation's.

result.implementation-defined: On request the implementation reports the edition 2025 (in SVRL, schematron-output/@schematronEdition).

test-case.name: edition-whitespace
test-case.description: schematronEdition with leading and trailing whitespace.

result.implementation-defined: Annex A types schematronEdition as xsd:token, whose value is 2025, and 5.3 says such whitespace should be stripped: a processor that strips it reports one failed-assert at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[2]; one that compares the raw value finds an edition other than 2025 (5.5.15).
